data.narrative:
Ample is a Series C-stage climate and energy company that has raised $720.2M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of nine private companies and one public peer (LNZA) operating in the same sector, including KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy at equivalent funding stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a valuation proxy, applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $1.2B. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-stage comparables—KoBold Metals ($3.0B), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B), and Amogy ($700M)—produces a median implied valuation of $1.0B, with an observed range of $700M to $3.0B.

The two methods converge on a valuation range of $850M to $1.4B, with a median estimate of $1.1B. This narrow convergence reflects consistency between capital-based progression and peer multiples. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion in peer valuations (a 4.3x spread from min to max), the reliance on a small peer sample of three companies, and absent disclosed precedent pricing that might validate step-up assumptions specific to this sector.
